rule: Select the smallest common registered budget for which the immediately preceding doubling passes in the 1D CRR-boundary, 5D LSM and 5D neural sweeps. Each gate is abs(mean(previous U-current U)) < current outer SE. Use the fixed 2000 5D outer paths; the 1D validation uses its registered 3000. No interpolation or c/n correction. If the intersection is empty, leave sizes unset.
reason: A 5D-only candidate does not resolve the separately required 1D convergence check.
